result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would erase the illusion of separation—the belief that we are isolated individuals competing for limited resources, rather than an interconnected web of life sharing the same breath, the same soil, the same fate.

This shift wouldn’t just end wars or poverty; it would dissolve the very roots of greed, fear, and exploitation. We’d see that harming another is harming ourselves, that hoarding from one is starving all, that the earth’s suffering is our own. Not as a moral lesson, but as an undeniable truth, like gravity.

The change wouldn’t be in systems or laws first—it would be in perception. And from that, everything else would follow.

What about you? What’s the one thread you’d pull to unravel the whole tapestry?
